scripts.build: npm run clean && (cd bookshelf && npm install && npm run build) && (cd study-assistant && npm install && npm run build) && npm run build:worker
scripts.clean: rm -rf app/bookshelf app/study-assistant bookshelf/.next study-assistant/.next bookshelf/out study-assistant/out
scripts.build:bookshelf: rm -rf app/bookshelf && cd bookshelf && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:assistant: rm -rf app/study-assistant && cd study-assistant && npm install && npm run build
